name: Article 3, § 5 – 92
title: REPORT on the proposal for a regulation of the European Parliament and of the Council establishing the Temporary Decarbonisation Fund
part_text: Modification (5) The administrative costs incurred by the Commission for the implementation of the Fund shall be covered by the resources mentioned in paragraph 1. The administrative costs covered by the Fund shall not exceed 2 % of the total resources of the Fund made available in accordance with paragraph 2.
